Chakrata

AT A GLANCE

About the Trip

A relaxed weekend escape from Delhi into the pine forests and viewpoints of Chakrata. Visit the Lokhandi Snow View Point, take an easy trek to Moila Top and the Budher Caves, catch the sunset from Chirmiri Point, and cool off at the majestic Tiger Falls — all in a short 2-day window that works perfectly for a weekend off.

Unlike a full Himalayan trek, this trip is easy-paced and beginner-friendly — ideal for a first-timer, a college group, or anyone short on leave days but not on wanderlust.

BASE
Chakrata, Uttarakhand
REGION
Dehradun District, UK
TREK GRADE
Easy
MEALS
2 breakfasts & 1 dinner
WHAT AWAITS YOU

Highlights of the Trip

Scenic weekend getaway — a full Himalayan escape that fits into a single weekend off.

Lokhandi Snow View Point — one of Chakrata's most beautiful viewpoints.

Easy trek to Moila Top — beginner-friendly, with the famous Budher Caves along the way.

Chirmiri Sunset Point — a mesmerizing sunset over the Chakrata hills.

The majestic Tiger Falls — a short trek down to one of the region's best waterfalls.

Local Chakrata Market — browse and shop before the journey back.

Bonfire & music evening — subject to availability and weather.

An experienced Trip Captain — with you throughout the journey, Delhi to Delhi.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

Tap a day to see the full plan.

  • Assembly: Assemble at Akshardham Metro Station between 9:30 PM – 10:30 PM.
  • Meet & Greet: Meet your Trip Captain and fellow travelers.
  • Departure: Board the vehicle and begin your journey towards Chakrata.
  • On the Way: Enjoy fun introductions, music, and group bonding activities.
  • Dinner Halt: Halt at a roadside dhaba for refreshments and dinner (self-paid).
  • Travel: Overnight journey to Chakrata.
  • Arrival: Reach Chakrata, check in to the hotel/campsite and enjoy breakfast.
  • Lokhandi Point: Visit Lokhandi Snow View Point.
  • Trek: Trek to Moila Top and explore the famous Budher Caves.
  • Sunset: Witness a mesmerizing sunset from Chirmiri Sunset Point.
  • Evening: Return to the stay for bonfire, dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Wake up to beautiful mountain views and enjoy breakfast.
  • Check-Out: Check out from the stay.
  • Tiger Falls: Visit Tiger Falls, followed by a short trek to the waterfall.
  • Market: Explore the local Chakrata Market.
  • Return Journey: Begin the return journey to Delhi with dinner halt en route.
  • Arrival: Reach Delhi the following morning.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Comfortable transportation from Delhi to Chakrata
  • 1 night stay in Hotel / Campsite
  • Total 3 meals included (2 breakfast, 1 dinner)
  • All sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary
  • Trip led and managed by an experienced Trip Captain
  • Bonfire and music evening (subject to weather conditions)
  • Toll taxes, parking fees, and driver allowances
  • Complete trip assistance and on-ground support

Not included in your package

  • Any meals not mentioned in the inclusions
  • Early check-in at hotels
  • Additional services like room heaters
  • Personal expenses of any kind
  • Meals during travel or sightseeing
  • Tips, laundry, wines, liquor, and mineral water
  • Telephone charges, camera fees, or other personal items
  • 4x4 vehicle charges (if required due to weather, road conditions, or government restrictions)
